Hi Maria,

Thanks again for partnering with us at the Paris Summit last week — it was a good turnout and we appreciated the co-marketing support. I've attached our initial post-show report (RDT_Paris_postshow_report_v1.xlsx) with the lead list and how we matched to Redwood-sourced activity. Key topline: 84 net leads captured, 12 marked as sales-accepted (SQL) by our SDRs, and $112k in influenced pipeline across three opportunities.

Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm the two leads flagged in green on tab "contested" — ReachTech's CRM shows different lifecycle stages for those contacts.
- Are you good with Redwood taking full credit on the eight SQLs listed as 'redwood-sourced' in column H, or would you like to propose a split?

We've called out sources and event-metadata in the attached sheet. Please confirm by EOD Tuesday so we can lock the crediting before invoicing for the co-sponsor fee.

Thanks,

Soojin —

Thanks for the report and for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the list and have two items to flag: the contacts highlighted in rows 203 and 214 (J. Moreau and S. Dubois) were already in ReachTech's nurture flow as MQLs prior to the event and were converted to SQL only after our SDR outreach on July 10. Our CRM export (snippet below) shows initial activity earlier in June.

On process: happy to do a provisional split if you propose one; otherwise we'll need a short reconciliation window to align on source-of-truth (HubSpot timeline + event check-in logs).

Hi Maria — looping in Sales Ops.

Thanks for calling that out. To keep the reconciliation quick, can you share the HubSpot timeline exports for J. Moreau and S. Dubois (or give us the HubSpot links)? We've pulled our event check-in logs and the two contacts were marked as "attended" on July 9 with explicit booth engagement. That said, we've seen cases where late-stage CRM edits post-event shift attribution.

I've attached a CSV export of our Event check-in -> CRM join (CRM_export_20260714.csv) and included a short mapping of fields we used to match records. As a proposed pragmatic path forward:
- If ReachTech's timeline shows pre-event conversion to SQL (with activity dated before July 9), ReachTech gets full credit.
- If conversion occurs after July 9 and there's clear booth interaction from our logs, we propose splitting credit 60/40 in Redwood's favor.

If neither side has a clear time-stamped source-of-truth, we should do a provisional 50/50 and finish the final tie-break within two weeks.

Laurel (cc: Vivek), can you weigh in on any billing or invoicing implications?

Thanks,
--
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-07-20T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: ReachTech Paris Summit — post-show credit allocation

Thanks all — quick escalation from my side. We appreciate ReachTech's diligence; ReachTech is a strategic partner and I'd prefer we close this without impacting the co-sponsor billing workflow. Proposed approach:

1) For the two contested contacts (Moreau, Dubois) let's apply a provisional 50/50 revenue/credit split while we run a timestamped reconciliation between HubSpot timelines and our event check-in logs (TTL: 7 days).
2) If Redwood's logs show booth engagement with timestamps before any ReachTech lead conversion event, Redwood receives the additional 10% credit (i.e., move to a 60/40 split).
3) Final reconciliation to result in a single invoice adjustment (if any) — Sales Ops to prepare a single invoice delta and both finance teams sign-off.

If ReachTech agrees to provisional 50/50, we'll proceed with the co-sponsor invoice at the net amount (adjustment to follow). Please confirm and we'll lock the timeline (we can commit to delivering a reconciled file by Aug 2).

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference

- We need the final reconciliation and any invoice adjustments no later than Aug 2 (our finance window closes Aug 5).
- Here's the HubSpot timeline link for J. Moreau: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/67890/contact/67890/timeline

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Maria

Maria —

Attached is the reconciled file (RDT_Paris_postshow_final_adjusted.xlsx) and the invoice adjustment PDF (invoice-adjustment-RT-778.pdf). Summary of resolution:
- Two contested contacts (J. Moreau, S. Dubois) — provisional split applied 50/50 per agreement. Timestamp evidence: booth check-in at 2026-07-09T11:22:00Z; earliest ReachTech "lead created" events for those contacts are 2026-07-10T08:15:00Z and 2026-07-12T09:10:00Z respectively. Per the heuristic we shared, split was applied.
- Eight Redwood-sourced SQLs retained full credit.
- Net invoice impact: Redwood issued a credit of €1,200 to ReachTech (see invoice-adjustment-RT-778.pdf).

Per request we included a short notes tab in the spreadsheet describing the matching heuristics (check-in timestamp vs HubSpot "lead created"), and a link to the HubSpot timelines you provided. Let us know if your finance team needs any additional fields for the invoice delta.

Thanks for moving this quickly — I'll mark the matter closed on our side once you confirm receipt of the adjusted invoice.
